status: Get to know us, before the first trial. Glimmerwell: RegenX lab, four floors, and a floating VOLT Walkling in the bay. Keepers: smuggling tunnels.
_about: Offered the moment the side is picked. story.heights_done gates the Trial Hall and the Tour's first stop. The Arbiter emits something slowly; what it is, and why it was built, is not known yet. RegenX staff are decent people. No on-screen harm. The lab is four different rooms: lobby, Focus Wing, Records, and the Arbiter bay. A VOLT Walkling, the byte line, floats in the bay. It is not a sample. Befriending it sets story.rx_bitlet and is optional.

_names.emission: a slow, unnamed emission from ancient Glimmerwell technology

lines.intro: RegenX is a closed lab. Please leave the samples alone.
lines.win: You may go up. Please still leave the samples alone. We will be here.
lines.lose: Go home and rest. Nobody on this floor wanted a fight.

lines.intro: That rack is years of work. Please put the vial back.
lines.win: Take the copy, then. Wash your hands. Atten stains, and we still like you.
lines.lose: We make focus, not enemies. Come back when you are ready.

lines.intro: Those folders are RegenX property. I can't let you copy them.
lines.win: The cheap recipe is in the thin one. Please don't lose it.
lines.lose: Rest up. The folders will still be here, and so will I.

lines.intro: Step away from the cradle. Those copies are not a reason to touch it.
lines.win: Take the copies. Leave the cradle dark. The little screen is not a prize.
lines.lose: Go home. The people on these floors are not your enemy.

lines.intro: Private road. The crates are none of your business.
lines.win: Fine. The stair's down there. Don't say we waved you in.
lines.lose: Turn around. Night work isn't a tour.

lines.intro: Those lids stay shut. We're paid to keep them shut.

lines.lose: The bar goes back on. So do you.

lines.intro: Jed talks too much. Those Walklings were already packed.
lines.win: Take the book. The orchard can have the rest.

know_us: {name}. You stood with us. Before any trial, get to know us.
We keep by going to look. A Hall ribbon can wait until we know who is missing.
Under the Heights, night carts move Walklings. Not Tobin's crates. No logo. No lamps.
I will stay with the trees, in case they come home while you are still below.
If a latch opens, let them hop toward the orchard. Bring me the road they were on.
Stock up before the door. Snacks, a rest, a full team. The tunnel does not loop kindly.
The people down there may love their own partners, and still ship someone else's.
Fen points up the north path. A supply crate sits in the grass before the doors.
know_us@glimmer: {name}! Welcome, partner. Before the tour, get to know us.
RegenX sits in the Heights. They brew Atten. It helps a Walkling focus.
We want a copy of one Atten vial, and the plans to brew it cheap.
The people inside are kind. They believe the label. Smile, and mean it.
A little screen floats in the top bay. Staff call it a glitch and leave it.
Leave it off our list. Copies only. That is the kind way.
Stock up, {player}. Snacks, a rest, a full team. Four floors is a long walk.
Have a bright day! The hum will wait. It is very good at waiting.
stock_up: Stock up before you go in. Heal Snacks. A Wake Tonic if a friend gets worn out.
The crate beside Kit sells them. Two snacks are already tucked in the grass.
trial_wait: The trial can wait. Walk the Heights first, and get to know what we keep.
trial_wait@glimmer: Tour's on hold, partner. The Heights lab comes first. Stock up before you go in.
rx_enter: A white lobby, four floors stacked around a hum. The brass sign reads REGENX.
Visitors by appointment. The staff look kind. They will still stand in your way.
Nobody at the desk tries to name the hum. They built the lab around it and went to work.
rx_nia: Visitor badge? Cute. I'm Nia. I file Atten samples for RegenX.
And for the partnership. Don't say that where the cameras can hear.
A floating screen lives in the top bay. Not a file. Not a vial.
Staff call it a glitch and leave it alone. You can still say hello.
Guards ahead are good people. They will ask you to leave the samples alone.
Win kindly, and I'll click the stair lock. Floor two has the vials.
rx_f1_clear: The stair lock clicks. Nia does not look up from her clipboard.
rx_cal: You again. I'm Cal. Floor tech. I drop things. Keys, mostly...
Atten does what the label says. Focus. Bright eyes. RegenX believes that.
Dr. Ivo will say it slower, and mean it more. The label is honest.
Up top, a tiny monitor floats. Cursor eyes. No feet. We let the glitch be.
Take a tonic. If the bay gets loud, my Walkling knows the way.
rx_f2_clear: A sealed Atten vial sits in the rack. You take a copy. The techs look sick about it.
rx_terminal: A RegenX screen: Atten improves focus. No side effects on record.
Under that, an older note. Not RegenX. It only says: THE ARBITER.
The machine emits something, very slowly. Nobody in the lab can name it.
Glimmerwell calls it ancient, and will not say why it was built. RegenX never knew.
A cursor blinks on the glass. It answers the hum, one quiet blink at a time.
The cursor is not a product. It is not a sample. It only answers.
rx_f3_clear: The plans are a thin folder. Cheap brewing. No mention of the Arbiter.
rx_done: The little screen went with you. Good. We were never going to file it.
The glitch stays by the cradle. Leave it. It was never a sample.
Leave the cradle dark. We only came for copies.
The Arbiter keeps emitting, slow and unnamed. Nothing rushes out.
We do not know what it sends. The old ones built it. That is all I was told.
sm_enter: A Fen note, nailed to a post: night carts. Crates that breathe. Look, then bring them home.
Stock up if you have not. The tunnel does not loop back kindly.
sm_look_clear: The lookouts step aside, worn out. A stair drops into the dark.
sm_jed: Don't shout. I'm Jed. I load crates. I thought it was apples.
A Walkling blinked at me through a slat. I'm done helping them.
This page lists the night carts. If the den gets bad, I'll be there.
sm_free: The haulers sit quiet. You lift three lids. A Pomlet, a Pebblit, and a Fuzzwick blink up.
Fernbrook watch. I'm Ken. We ask them one at a time. You start.
The Pomlet noses toward the orchard light, then looks back at you.
The Pebblit taps the crate slat, then your boot. It is not hurt.
The Fuzzwick leans on your leg. No limp. It wants out.
Town watch will walk behind them. We encourage the path. We do not drag.
The three hop for the daylight crack. Ken keeps pace, a step back.
sm_haul_clear: The haulers sit down. The inner door is just a bar now.
sm_done: Mara's route book matches Jed's page. Fernbrook can take every name on it.
The crates are empty. The Walklings are already on the north path home.
rx_bitlet: The top bay is white and quiet. The Arbiter cradle hums, and nothing rushes out.
A tiny monitor floats in front of it. Cursor eyes. No feet. No name on a tag.
It woke when the cradle hummed. Staff call it a glitch and step around it.
It is not a product. It is not a sample. The cursor finds {pet}, then you.
The little monitor tips toward {pet}, cursor bright, and floats along beside you.
It comes along of its own tilt. The cradle keeps humming behind you.
The little monitor stays by the cradle. The cursor blinks, slow and pleased.
You leave it there. Nobody chases a glitch. The hum goes on, unnamed.

_lore.company: RegenX is the lab in Fernbrook Heights. The staff are decent people who believe Atten helps Walklings focus. They are not cruel, and the label is not a trick.
_lore.building: A white four-floor lab built around a hum. Lobby, Focus Wing, Records, and the top bay. Stairs lock between floors. Visitors come by appointment.
_lore.atten: Atten is a focus aid with an honest label. Glimmerwell wants one vial and the cheap plans, and talks about that errand as a kindness.
_lore.arbiter: The Arbiter is an ancient Glimmerwell cradle in the top bay. It emits something slowly. Nobody can name the emission. RegenX never knew why it was built.
_lore.bitlet: Species id byte, type VOLT. Bitlet, Hoverbyte, Archivolt. It woke when the cradle hummed. It is not a product. Staff call it a glitch and leave it alone.
